instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a 'Light Mode' first philosophy. Dark mode is optional/secondary.
Use 'Manrope' for all Headings (h1-h4) and 'Inter' for body text. Import them via Google Fonts in index.html or CSS.
Authentication: Use Google OAuth flow. The login page should split screen with the 'auth_background' image on one side with a blue overlay.
Dashboard: Create a sidebar navigation with clear iconography (Lucide React).
Forms: For the Quotation Engine (Motor de Cotización), use a 'Stepper' pattern (Step 1: Client, Step 2: Services, Step 3: Hardware, Step 4: Review).
Tables: Since tables are complex (Banks, Services), implement columns with text wrapping logic and sticky headers.
PDF Export: Use a 'Preview' modal before generating the final PDF. The preview should look exactly like the paper document.
Currency: Display dual prices (USD/Bs) clearly. Use a pill or badge for currency labels.
Graphs: Use Recharts for the Dashboard summary (e.g., Quotes per Month).
Icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics; focus on crisp, professional borders and whitespace.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical defaults (p-6, p-8).
Interactive elements must have clear hover/active states.
Use existing Shadcn components from /src/components/ui/ whenever possible, customizing them via className.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure WCAG AA compliance (4.5:1 for normal text).
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements.
